title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers: Redemption Conditions
content:
The following conditions govern redemption of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers, meaning the use of credit value to pay for a new ticket or an eligible fee.

**1. Status.** A credit can be redeemed only while its status is active. This applies to the redemption and to any forfeit of a remainder that follows it, and the credit's status as the system records it is the evidence.

**2. Expiry.** A credit can be redeemed only on or before its expiry date as recorded on the credit, plus a redemption grace period of 0 calendar days. The expiry date is inclusive, so a booking made on the expiry date itself is accepted, counted in calendar days in US Central time.

| Hypothetical credit expiring 30 September | Booking date (US Central time) | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Booking on the expiry date | 30 September | Accepted |
| Booking the day after | 1 October | Not accepted; there is no grace period |

**3. Start of travel.** Where the instrument requires travel to begin by the expiry date, the first flight of the ticket paid must also depart on or before the expiry date. Where it does not, travel may take place after the expiry date.

**4. Who may travel.** The passenger ticketed must fall within the instrument's traveler scope. Named traveler only requires the passenger to be the traveler named on the credit. Holder's reservation requires the traveler named on the credit to be ticketed on the same reservation. Anyone allows any passenger. No credit pays for more distinct passengers than the instrument's maximum per credit.

**5. Companion and partner tickets.** A credit may pay a companion ticket only where its instrument may pay companion tickets. A credit may never pay a partner-operated ticket where its instrument may not pay partner flights.

**6. Telephone redemption.** The former clause that a redemption through the reservations call center carries the instrument's telephone redemption fee per ticket, charged as a separate fee entry linked to the redemption, is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis for the telephone fee. No telephone fee arises where the instrument cannot be redeemed online, or where the customer's Summit tier under the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program waives credit service fees.

**7. Partial use.** When a redemption uses less than the remaining value, what happens to the remainder depends on the instrument. Where the instrument retains remaining value, the remainder stays on the credit. Where the instrument forfeits it, the remainder is forfeited in a separate forfeit entry.

**8. Depletion.** When the remaining value reaches zero the credit becomes depleted.

## Hypothetical partial redemption

A credit with a remaining value of 200.00 US dollars pays 140.00 toward a ticket. On an instrument that retains remaining value, 60.00 stays on the credit. On an instrument that forfeits it, 60.00 is forfeited in a separate forfeit entry, the remaining value reaches zero, and the credit becomes depleted.

superseded_clauses: A redemption through the reservations call center carries phone_redemption_fee per ticket, charged as a separate fee entry linked to the redemption
